summary.one_liner: A Python Discord bot that brings OpenAI chat, vision, image generation, transcription, moderation, and web search into Discord servers.
summary.what_it_does: The bot exposes slash commands such as /gpt ask and /gpt converse for Chat Completions models (including vision and reasoning models), /web for recent information using the Responses API with native web search and visible source links, and /dalle draw for image generation via the GPT Image API. Transcription and moderation use current OpenAI APIs. It supports long conversations, per-user API keys, server role restrictions, prompt optimization, and saved conversations. Optional integrations cover document indexing (LlamaIndex), internet chat with OpenAI or Google search, Qdrant or Pinecone memory, Replicate fallback vision, DeepL translation, and E2B code execution, each installed as separate extras. Configuration is through a .env file, and Docker Compose is supported.
use_cases: chat with an OpenAI model inside a Discord server
generate images from Discord with /dalle draw
search the web for recent information with source links
transcribe audio or video in Discord
index documents and chat with them in Discord
restrict bot access to specific Discord roles
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cd into GPTDiscord
cp sample.env .env, then set OPENAI_API_KEY, DISCORD_TOKEN, ALLOWED_GUILDS and DATA_DIR
stack: OpenAI API (Chat Completions, Responses, GPT Image, moderation, transcription)
notable: Uses the OpenAI Responses API with native web search for /web, with visible source links
Role-based access control via BOT_ACCESS_ROLE_IDS with role IDs that survive renames
Optional conversation recovery mode for servers where gateway delivery is unreliable
Optional extras (index, search, pinecone, qdrant, code, replicate, full) keep the basic bot lightweight
Generated images offer Vary controls using the GPT Image edit API
caveats: Requires an OpenAI API project key; ChatGPT subscriptions do not include API billing
Search tool calls and image, audio and tool fees are billed separately from token usage; the local usage total is only an estimate
Discord bot needs Server Members and Message Content privileged intents enabled
Model names and availability depend on the OpenAI project and change over time
